paragraphs: R. Chana Shauna, student of R. Yochanan. Avodah Zarah 75a: R. Chana Shauna—or some say R. Chana bar Shauna—said: Rabbah bar bar Chana said: R. Yochanan said. That matter in Niddah 65b has Chana Shauna. I do not know the basis for saying he was R. Yochanan's student, since he spoke in Rabbah bar bar Chana's name, who spoke in R. Yochanan's name. Vayikra Rabbah, section 5: R. Yochanan bar Shauna, and R. Levi spoke in his name. Arukh, entry Bar Hadya, has bar Shechina. It seems they are one person.
